<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Workshop Puericultura na Prática — Dra. Greter Fernandez</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  :root {
    --teal: #62ACA6;
    --teal-dark: #3d7d78;
    --teal-deep: #1a4a47;
    --mint: #A8D5D1;
    --mint-light: #EAF6F4;
    --dark: #1a2e2d;
    --dark2: #0e1e1d;
    --cream: #faf8f5;
    --cream2: #f3efe8;
    --gold: #c9a84c;
    --gold-light: #f0e0b0;
    --text: #2a3a39;
    --text-light: #5a7370;
  }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); overflow-x: hidden; }

  /* ANIMATIONS */
  @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(32px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity:0; } to { opacity:1; } }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { transform:scale(1); } 50% { transform:scale(1.03); } }
  @keyframes shimmer { 0% { background-position: -200% center; } 100% { background-position: 200% center; } }
  @keyframes floatDot { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:.4; } 50% { transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.2); opacity:.8; } }
  .fade-up { animation: fadeUp .8s ease forwards; }
  .fade-up-2 { animation: fadeUp .8s .15s ease forwards; opacity:0; }
  .fade-up-3 { animation: fadeUp .8s .3s ease forwards; opacity:0; }
  .fade-up-4 { animation: fadeUp .8s .45s ease forwards; opacity:0; }

  /* STICKY CTA BAR */
  .sticky-bar {
    position: fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:100;
    background: rgba(26,46,45,.97); backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    padding:.7rem 2rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(98,172,166,.3);
    transform:translateY(-100%); transition:transform .4s ease;
  }
  .sticky-bar.visible { transform:translateY(0); }
  .sticky-bar-text { color:var(--mint); font-size:.82rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.05em; }
  .sticky-bar-text span { color:white; font-weight:600; }
  .btn-sticky {
    background: var(--gold); color: var(--dark2); padding:.5rem 1.4rem;
    border-radius:4px; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none;
    letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap;
    transition: all .2s;
  }
  .btn-sticky:hover { background:#e0bc6a; transform:translateY(-1px); }

  /* HERO */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: var(--dark2);
    position: relative; overflow:hidden;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding: 6rem 2rem 4rem;
  }
  .hero-bg {
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 60% 40%, rgba(98,172,166,.18) 0%, transparent 70%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 10% 80%, rgba(201,168,76,.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
                linear-gradient(160deg, #0e1e1d 0%, #1a2e2d 50%, #0a1a19 100%);
  }
  .hero-dots {
    position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none;
  }
  .dot {
    position:absolute; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal);
    animation: floatDot linear infinite;
  }
  .hero-content { position:relative; z-index:2; max-width:860px; text-align:center; }
  .hero-badge {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem;
    background:rgba(98,172,166,.15); border:1px solid rgba(98,172,166,.35);
    padding:.4rem 1.2rem; border-radius:50px; margin-bottom:2rem;
    color:var(--mint); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.15em; text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .hero-badge::before { content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); animation:pulse 2s infinite; }
  .hero-title {
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 5rem);
    font-weight:300; line-height:1.1;
    color:white; margin-bottom:1rem; letter-spacing:-.02em;
  }
  .hero-title em { font-style:italic; color:var(--mint); }
  .hero-title strong { font-weight:700; display:block; }
  .hero-subtitle {
    font-size:1.05rem; color:rgba(168,213,209,.8); font-weight:300;
    margin-bottom:2.5rem; line-height:1.7; max-width:620px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;
  }
  .hero-meta {
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2rem;
    margin-bottom:2.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .hero-meta-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size:.85rem; }
  .hero-meta-item svg { color:var(--teal); flex-shrink:0; }
  .btn-hero {
    display:inline-block;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #e0bc6a);
    color: var(--dark2); padding:1rem 3rem; border-radius:4px;
    font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none;
    letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase;
    box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(201,168,76,.35);
    transition: all .3s; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .btn-hero::after {
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.25), transparent);
    background-size:200% 100%; animation:shimmer 2.5s infinite;
  }
  .btn-hero:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(201,168,76,.45); }
  .hero-note { margin-top:1rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); font-size:.78rem; }
  .hero-scroll {
    position:absolute; bottom:2rem; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    color:rgba(255,255,255,.3); font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.15em;
    text-transform:uppercase; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.4rem;
  }
  .hero-scroll-line { width:1px; height:40px; background:linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--teal), transparent); }

  /* SECTIONS */
  section { padding:5rem 2rem; }
  .container { max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  .section-label {
    font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--teal); margin-bottom:.75rem;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size:clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); font-weight:400; line-height:1.2;
    color:var(--dark); margin-bottom:1rem;
  }
  .section-title em { font-style:italic; color:var(--teal); }

  /* PAIN SECTION */
  .pain { background:var(--cream2); }
  .pain-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:1.5rem; margin-top:3rem; }
  .pain-card {
    background:white; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem;
    border-left:3px solid var(--teal); position:relative;
    box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  }
  .pain-card-icon { font-size:1.5rem; margin-bottom:.75rem; }
  .pain-card h3 { font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--dark); margin-bottom:.4rem; }
  .pain-card p { font-size:.85rem; color:var(--text-light); line-height:1.7; }

  /* FOR WHOM */
  .forwhom { background:var(--dark); }
  .forwhom .section-label { color:var(--mint); }
  .forwhom .section-title { color:white; }
  .forwhom-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap:1.5rem; margin-top:3rem; }
  .forwhom-card {
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); border:1px solid rgba(98,172,166,.2);
    border-radius:10px; padding:1.8rem 1.5rem; text-align:center;
    transition:all .3s;
  }
  .forwhom-card:hover { background:rgba(98,172,166,.1); border-color:rgba(98,172,166,.5); transform:translateY(-4px); }
  .forwhom-card-icon { font-size:2rem; margin-bottom:1rem; }
  .forwhom-card h3 { color:white; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:.5rem; }
  .forwhom-card p { color:rgba(168,213,209,.7); font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.6; }

  /* CONTENT */
  .content-section { background:var(--mint-light); }
  .days-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:2rem; margin-top:3rem; }
  .day-card {
    background:white; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  }
  .day-header {
    background:var(--teal); padding:1.2rem 1.5rem;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem;
  }
  .day-number {
    width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    color:white; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .day-header-text h3 { color:white; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:700; }
  .day-header-text p { color:rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size:.75rem; margin-top:.1rem; }
  .day-body { padding:1.5rem; }
  .day-item {
    display:flex; gap:.75rem; align-items:flex-start;
    padding:.6rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;
  }
  .day-item:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
  .day-item-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); flex-shrink:0; margin-top:.35rem; }
  .day-item p { font-size:.85rem; color:var(--text); line-height:1.5; }

  /* INSTRUCTOR */
  .instructor { background:white; }
  .instructor-inner {
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr; gap:4rem; align-items:center;
  }
  .instructor-photo {
    aspect-ratio:3/4; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; position:relative;
    background:var(--mint-light);
  }
  .instructor-photo-placeholder {
    width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:1rem;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mint-light), var(--teal));
    color:white; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  }
  .instructor-photo-placeholder span { font-size:3rem; }
  .instructor-photo-placeholder p { font-size:1.1rem; font-style:italic; }
  .instructor-content .section-label { margin-bottom:.5rem; }
  .instructor-name {
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:400;
    color:var(--dark); margin-bottom:.25rem;
  }
  .instructor-cred { color:var(--teal); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:500; margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
  .instructor-bio { color:var(--text-light); font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.8; margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
  .instructor-stats { display:flex; gap:2rem; }
  .stat { text-align:center; }
  .stat-num { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--teal); display:block; }
  .stat-label { font-size:.72rem; color:var(--text-light); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.1em; }

  /* PRICING */
  .pricing { background:var(--dark2); }
  .pricing .section-label { color:var(--mint); }
  .pricing .section-title { color:white; }
  .pricing-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:1.5rem; margin-top:3rem; }
  .price-card {
    border-radius:12px; padding:2rem 1.5rem; text-align:center;
    border:1px solid rgba(98,172,166,.2); position:relative;
    transition:all .3s;
  }
  .price-card.featured {
    background:var(--teal); border-color:var(--teal);
    transform:scale(1.04);
    box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(98,172,166,.3);
  }
  .price-card:not(.featured) { background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
  .price-card:hover:not(.featured) { background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-color:rgba(98,172,166,.4); }
  .price-tag {
    display:inline-block; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.12em;
    text-transform:uppercase; padding:.3rem .8rem; border-radius:50px; margin-bottom:1rem;
  }
  .price-card.featured .price-tag { background:rgba(255,255,255,.2); color:white; }
  .price-card:not(.featured) .price-tag { background:rgba(98,172,166,.15); color:var(--mint); }
  .price-batch { color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); font-size:.8rem; margin-bottom:.25rem; }
  .price-card.featured .price-batch { color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
  .price-amount { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:3rem; font-weight:700; color:white; line-height:1; }
  .price-card.featured .price-amount { color:white; }
  .price-seats { font-size:.78rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); margin-top:.3rem; margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
  .price-card.featured .price-seats { color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
  .price-includes { text-align:left; margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
  .price-includes li {
    font-size:.82rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); padding:.3rem 0;
    display:flex; gap:.5rem; align-items:flex-start; list-style:none;
  }
  .price-card.featured .price-includes li { color:rgba(255,255,255,.9); }
  .price-includes li::before { content:'✓'; color:var(--mint); font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0; }
  .price-card.featured .price-includes li::before { color:rgba(255,255,255,.9); }
  .btn-price {
    display:block; padding:.8rem; border-radius:6px;
    font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase;
    text-decoration:none; text-align:center; transition:all .2s;
  }
  .price-card.featured .btn-price { background:white; color:var(--teal-dark); }
  .price-card.featured .btn-price:hover { background:var(--mint-light); }
  .price-card:not(.featured) .btn-price { background:rgba(98,172,166,.2); color:var(--mint); border:1px solid rgba(98,172,166,.3); }
  .price-card:not(.featured) .btn-price:hover { background:rgba(98,172,166,.35); }

  /* GUARANTEE */
  .guarantee {
    background:var(--mint-light);
    text-align:center; padding:4rem 2rem;
  }
  .guarantee-box {
    max-width:620px; margin:0 auto;
    background:white; border-radius:12px; padding:3rem;
    box-shadow:0 4px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
    border-top:4px solid var(--teal);
  }
  .guarantee-icon { font-size:3rem; margin-bottom:1rem; }
  .guarantee-title { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1.8rem; color:var(--dark); margin-bottom:1rem; }
  .guarantee-text { color:var(--text-light); font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.8; }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq { background:white; }
  .faq-list { margin-top:3rem; max-width:720px; }
  .faq-item { border-bottom:1px solid #eee; }
  .faq-q {
    width:100%; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    padding:1.2rem 0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    font-family:'Jost',sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--dark);
    text-align:left; gap:1rem;
  }
  .faq-q:hover { color:var(--teal); }
  .faq-icon { color:var(--teal); font-size:1.2rem; flex-shrink:0; transition:transform .3s; }
  .faq-item.open .faq-icon { transform:rotate(45deg); }
  .faq-a { display:none; padding-bottom:1.2rem; color:var(--text-light); font-size:.88rem; line-height:1.8; }
  .faq-item.open .faq-a { display:block; }

  /* FINAL CTA */
  .final-cta {
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-deep), var(--dark));
    text-align:center; padding:6rem 2rem; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .final-cta::before {
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%, rgba(98,172,166,.2), transparent);
  }
  .final-cta-content { position:relative; z-index:1; max-width:620px; margin:0 auto; }
  .final-cta .section-label { color:var(--mint); text-align:center; }
  .final-cta-title { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.2rem); font-weight:300; color:white; margin-bottom:1rem; line-height:1.2; }
  .final-cta-title em { font-style:italic; color:var(--mint); }
  .final-cta-sub { color:rgba(168,213,209,.7); font-size:.9rem; margin-bottom:2.5rem; line-height:1.7; }
  .btn-final {
    display:inline-block; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #e0bc6a);
    color:var(--dark2); padding:1.1rem 3.5rem; border-radius:4px;
    font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none;
    letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase;
    box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(201,168,76,.35); transition:all .3s;
  }
  .btn-final:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(201,168,76,.5); }
  .final-note { margin-top:1rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.35); font-size:.78rem; }

  /* FOOTER */
  footer {
    background:var(--dark2); padding:2rem; text-align:center;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,.3); font-size:.78rem; border-top:1px solid rgba(98,172,166,.1);
  }
  footer a { color:var(--teal); text-decoration:none; }

  /* RESPONSIVE */
  @media(max-width:768px) {
    .pain-grid, .days-grid, .pricing-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .instructor-inner { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .instructor-photo { max-width:280px; margin:0 auto; }
    .price-card.featured { transform:none; }
    .hero-meta { gap:1rem; }
    .instructor-stats { gap:1rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- STICKY BAR -->
<div class="sticky-bar" id="stickyBar">
  <div class="sticky-bar-text"><span>Workshop Puericultura na Prática</span> — Lote 1: R$397 · Vagas limitadas</div>
  <a href="#inscricao" class="btn-sticky">Garantir vaga</a>
</div>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero" id="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg"></div>
  <div class="hero-dots" id="heroDots"></div>
  <div class="hero-content fade-up">
    <div class="hero-badge">Workshop Online ao Vivo + Gravação</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--teal); margin-bottom:.5rem;">Workshop</div>
    <h1 class="hero-title">
      <strong>Puericultura</strong>
      <em>na Prática</em>
    </h1>
    <p class="hero-subtitle fade-up-2">
      Para <strong style="color:white;">pediatras e médicos que atendem crianças no primeiro ano de vida</strong> — do pré-natal aos 12 meses, com método prático e aplicação imediata no consultório.
    </p>
    <div class="hero-meta fade-up-3">
      <div class="hero-meta-item">
        <svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/></svg>
        Em 2–3 meses · 2 dias de imersão
      </div>
      <div class="hero-meta-item">
        <svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>
        50 vagas · Turma exclusiva
      </div>
      <div class="hero-meta-item">
        <svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="23 7 16 12 23 17 23 7"/><rect x="1" y="5" width="15" height="14" rx="2"/></svg>
        Acesso à gravação incluso
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="fade-up-4">
      <a href="#inscricao" class="btn-hero">Quero garantir minha vaga</a>
      <p class="hero-note">🔒 Lote 1 — apenas 15 vagas a R$397</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-scroll">
    <div class="hero-scroll-line"></div>
    rolar
  </div>
</section>

<!-- DOR -->
<section class="pain">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">O problema que ninguém fala</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Você se identifica com <em>alguma dessas situações?</em></h2>
    <div class="pain-grid">
      <div class="pain-card">
        <div class="pain-card-icon">😰</div>
        <h3>Insegurança na consulta do recém-nascido</h3>
        <p>Aquela sensação de que faltam protocolos claros para orientar a família nas primeiras semanas — amamentação, perda de peso, icterícia, sono.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pain-card">
        <div class="pain-card-icon">🤔</div>
        <h3>Puericultura pré-natal ainda parece distante</h3>
        <p>Você sabe que ela existe, mas nunca ficou claro como estruturar esse atendimento nem como agregar valor para a gestante antes do nascimento.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pain-card">
        <div class="pain-card-icon">📚</div>
        <h3>Teoria demais, prática de menos</h3>
        <p>Os livros existem, os cursos são longos — mas na hora da consulta ainda falta um fio condutor prático para conduzir cada etapa com segurança.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pain-card">
        <div class="pain-card-icon">👶</div>
        <h3>Clínico geral atendendo bebês sem suporte</h3>
        <p>Pediatra não está sempre disponível, e você acaba atendendo crianças pequenas sem um método estruturado para o acompanhamento do primeiro ano.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
  // Sticky bar
  const stickyBar = document.getElementById('stickyBar');
  const hero = document.getElementById('hero');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (window.scrollY > hero.offsetHeight * 0.5) stickyBar.classList.add('visible');
    else stickyBar.classList.remove('visible');
  });

  // Hero dots
  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('heroDots');
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const dot = document.createElement('div');
    dot.className = 'dot';
    const size = Math.random() * 6 + 2;
    dot.style.cssText = `
      width:${size}px; height:${size}px;
      left:${Math.random()*100}%;
      top:${Math.random()*100}%;
      opacity:${Math.random()*.5+.1};
      animation-duration:${Math.random()*6+4}s;
      animation-delay:${Math.random()*4}s;
    `;
    dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
  }

  // FAQ
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const item = btn.parentElement;
      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
      if (!wasOpen) item.classList.add('open');
    });
  });
</script>
